There have been 96 prior macro-attempts in this family and 732 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0198/micro-0003 at 1423 parameters and 99.080000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002 (discard, 98.910000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 55 and 87, values 0.0051350105 and 0.0062126732 (difference 1.078e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,422 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.099e-03) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
